title: AI Gateway rejects requests with 'Insufficient funds' even though a BYOK provider key is configured
symptoms: Insufficient funds. Please add credits to your account to continue using AI services.
The dashboard Test Key for the BYOK credential succeeds
Requests fail only once the gateway credit balance reaches zero
cause: AI Gateway checks the credit balance before using BYOK credentials because it can fall back to its own providers when the BYOK call fails. A zero balance blocks the request even when your key would have served it.
fix: Keep a small positive credit balance on the team, or call the provider directly for traffic that must never touch gateway credits.
apply: Vercel dashboard > AI Gateway > Credits: keep a nonzero balance (consider auto top-up)
affected: Vercel AI Gateway with BYOK, confirmed as intended behavior in August 2026
